verdict.rationale: FreshBooks docs confirm invoice creation with customizable payment options, multiple online payment methods (cards, ACH, Apple/Google Pay, BNPL), and a Payments API with webhook notifications (e.g., invoice.create) enabling read status/paid tracking. This directly covers create/send invoices, online payment, and view/paid visibility. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or screenshot of an invoice 'viewed' read-receipt status in the UI, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the view-tracking feature beyond API/webhook inference.
